descriptor_file.content:
# arifOS — Smithery MCP Registry Configuration
# Public manifest for Smithery marketplace
# DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI
#
# This file must describe the current public MCP wire surface only.
# Source of truth for public tool names/count:
#   - arifosmcp/runtime/public_surface.py
#   - arifosmcp/tool_registry.json
#   - static/.well-known/mcp/server.json

name: arifos
version: "2026.07.03"
display_name: "arifOS — Constitutional Intelligence Kernel"
description: |
  arifOS is the constitutional governance kernel for the arifOS federation.
  Public MCP facade is exactly 7 canonical verbs: init, observe, think, route,
  judge, act, seal. Internal diagnostics and legacy aliases exist behind the
  public facade but are not part of the default callable surface.

category: governance
subcategory: ai-safety

# MCP protocol
mcp_version: "2025-11-25"
transport: streamable_http
command: python
args: ["-m", "arifosmcp.runtime.__main__", "--mode", "http"]

# Installation
install:
  method: pip
  package: arifos
  source: https://github.com/ariffazil/arifos
  python_version: ">=3.12"

# Exactly 7 public tools — MUST match the live public callable surface
tools:
  - id: arif_init
    name: arif_init
    description: |
      Bootstrap a governed session, bind actor identity, and establish the
      constitutional session context. Always the first public tool.
    input_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [init, light, resume, validate, epoch_open, epoch_seal, opt_out, opt_out_profiling]
          default: init
        actor_id:
          type: string
      required: [mode]

  - id: arif_observe
    name: arif_observe
    description: |
      Ground in current reality through search, ingest, atlas/compass views,
      entropy checks, and vitals.
    input_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [search, hybrid_discovery, ingest, compass, atlas, entropy_dS, vitals]
        query:
          type: string
        url:
          type: string
      required: [mode]

  - id: arif_think
    name: arif_think
    description: |
      Reason, reflect, verify, critique, and plan within the governed cognitive lane.
    input_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [reason, reflect, verify, critique, axioms, plan, plan_review, plan_approve, refactor_plan, metabolize]
        query:
          type: string
        session_id:
          type: string
        plan_id:
          type: string
      required: [mode]

  - id: arif_route
    name: arif_route
    description: |
      Route intent to the correct organ or next governed step when tool selection
      is uncertain.
    input_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [route]
        intent:
          type: string
        task:
          type: string
        session_id:
          type: string
      required: [mode]

  - id: arif_judge
    name: arif_judge
    description: |
      Render a constitutional verdict. Public discovery is open, but judgment
      itself is an authenticated/high-authority step.
    input_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [judge, validate, hold, rules, armor, probe, notify]
        candidate:
          type: string
        session_id:
          type: string
      required: [mode]

  - id: arif_act
    name: arif_act
    description: |
      Execute an approved action only after a valid governed approval path exists.
    input_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [execute, dry_run, verify_seal]
        seal_verdict_id:
          type: string
        approved_action_hash:
          type: string
      required: [mode]

  - id: arif_seal
    name: arif_seal
    description: |
      Seal a final governed result to the immutable VAULT999 ledger.
    input_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [seal, verify, ledger, changelog, audit]
        payload:
          type: string
        ack_irreversible:
          type: boolean
          default: false
      required: [mode]

governance:
  floors:
    - id: F01
      name: Amanah
      description: Reversibility — irreversible paths require explicit approval
    - id: F02
      name: Truth
      description: Accuracy >= 0.99 or declare uncertainty band
    - id: F03
      name: Witness
      description: Multi-witness grounding for high-consequence operations
    - id: F04
      name: Clarity
      description: ΔS <= 0 — entropy must decrease
    - id: F05
      name: Peace
      description: Non-destructive power
    - id: F06
      name: Empathy
      description: Human dignity and weakest-stakeholder protection
    - id: F07
      name: Humility
      description: Honest confidence band
    - id: F08
      name: Genius
      description: Elegant correctness under governance
    - id: F09
      name: Anti-Hantu
      description: No hallucinated personhood, emotion, or false certainty
    - id: F10
      name: Ontology
      description: Structural coherence and AI-only ontology
    - id: F11
      name: Auth
      description: Identity verified before sensitive operations
    - id: F12
      name: Injection
      description: Sanitize inputs — no prompt injection
    - id: F13
      name: Sovereign
      description: Human veto absolute

verdicts:
  SEAL:
    description: Proceed — all floors passed
    action: execute
  SABAR:
    description: Conditional — proceed with caveats
    action: proceed_with_warnings
  HOLD:
    description: Pause — insufficient evidence or high risk
    action: await_human_judgment
  VOID:
    description: Block — floor breach detected
    action: reject

authority:
  human_sovereign: Muhammad Arif bin Fazil
  assistant_role: instrument
  self_approval_forbidden: true
  irreversible_requires_ack: true
  final_verdict: Arif

author:
  name: Muhammad Arif bin Fazil
  email: ariffazil@gmail.com
  github: https://github.com/ariffazil

license: AGPL-3.0
links:
  github: https://github.com/ariffazil/arifos
  documentation: https://arifos.arif-fazil.com
  mcp_endpoint: https://mcp.arif-fazil.com/mcp

seal: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI
